briefing: Somebody watched your last fight, out past {HERE}, and did not look away.
A Fer-de-Lance works the lanes with two Asps at its side. Bring its pilot down, and we will talk again.
You will not find our name in any register. Call us {PATRON}.
dossier.lead: A note without a name waits for the commander at {WORLD}

mark.arrive: Bring down the Fer-de-Lance and its two Asps near {TARGET}
mark.success: The Fer-de-Lance is wreckage near {TARGET}, gang and all
mark.fail: The Fer-de-Lance walked away, and so did our chance near {TARGET}

dossier.news: Local traffic near {WORLD} carries talk that {PATRON} is paying for quiet work again

rumour.far: Traders near {WORLD} whisper that {PATRON} still watches every fight worth watching
rumour.near: A short line reaches the commander at {WORLD}: {PATRON} has not forgotten the Fer-de-Lance

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took on an unsigned job that pointed toward {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance and its Asps lay dead near {WORLD}, and the note went unanswered.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance escaped the guns near {WORLD}, and the silence never spoke again.

mark.targetDestroyed: Near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance and both Asps went down together.
mark.targetFled: Near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the wounded Fer-de-Lance fled the fight.
mark.targetEscaped: Near {WORLD} on day {DAY}, the Fer-de-Lance jumped clear before the kill.
mark.failed: By day {DAY}, the hunt near {WORLD} ran past its deadline.

dossier.title: A Note With No Name
